title: ros2 run ignores your conda or venv: No module named 'torch' and the #!/usr/bin/python3 fix (measured)
excerpt: colcon writes #!/usr/bin/python3 into Python node scripts, so ros2 run never sees packages installed in a conda env or venv. Measured on Humble and Jazzy: setup.cfg [build_scripts] executable = /usr/bin/env python3 fixes it, plus the pyyaml step Jazzy needs with conda.
